description: BidiIsolation.ALWAYS with an instance return-string handler whose text contains a placeholder-looking token, over a catalog that carries no translatable key. Distinguishes the three failure responses by whether isolation is reachable at all: RETURN_STRING returns translationFailureResponse.getTranslation() verbatim without interpolation (DefaultStrings.java:757-759), RETURN_KEY goes through interpolateFailureKey and does isolate (:754), and THROW_EXCEPTION reaches throwExceptionFor (:3196), which builds a MissingTranslationException from the raw key and touches neither the interpolator nor BidiUtils. Per-call handlers replace the instance one (:684), so all three run on one fixture.
